meta.name: nanogpt
meta.description: Educational GPT implementation in ~300 lines. Reproduces GPT-2 (124M) on OpenWebText. Clean, hackable code for learning transformers. By Andrej Karpathy. Perfect for understanding GPT architecture from scratch. Train on Shakespeare (CPU) or OpenWebText (multi-GPU).

copy.tagline: 用300行代码复现GPT-2，理解Transformer架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想从零动手实现GPT并理解其原理
copy.tagline_en: Reproduce GPT-2 in ~300 lines to understand Transformer architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to implement GPT from scratch and understand its internals

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以指导你使用 nanoGPT 代码库训练和生成文本。它提供从莎士比亚字符级模型到 GPT-2 124M 复现的完整流程，包括数据准备、训练和采样。
howto.when: 当你询问如何训练小型 GPT 模型、复现 GPT-2 或微调预训练模型时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 nanoGPT 在莎士比亚数据集上训练一个字符级模型。
say.note: Claude 会给出数据准备和训练命令。

say.text: 如何用 nanoGPT 复现 GPT-2 124M 参数？
say.note: Claude 会提供多 GPU 训练步骤。

say.text: 我想用 nanoGPT 微调 GPT-2 模型。
say.note: Claude 会说明如何加载预训练权重并设置微调参数。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you through training and generating text using the nanoGPT codebase. It covers complete workflows from character-level Shakespeare to GPT-2 124M reproduction, including data preparation, training, and sampling.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about training small GPT models, reproducing GPT-2, or fine-tuning pretrained models.

say_en.text: Help me train a character-level model on Shakespeare using nanoGPT.
say_en.note: Claude will provide data preparation and training commands.

say_en.text: How to reproduce GPT-2 124M with nanoGPT?
say_en.note: Claude will give multi-GPU training steps.
